_about: DRAFT region proposal for SVS 3912 'orig' 2048x1024 frames. Not scene.json. Owner: Student A.
status: regions chosen by Dev A on 2026-11-14; Student A checked land
shape: Circles, radius 61 px, same radius for both regions (Dev A).
map: Equirectangular 2048x1024. x = (lon + 180) * 2048 / 360, y = (90 - lat) * 1024 / 180. See map_geometry in source_manifest.json.
how_measured: analysis/explore_regions.py (Dev A's engine, default settings), frames 23000-23116 step 4 (30 frames). Land mask: grey land in most frames plus a 3 px coast margin.
for_scene_json: box_px is the square around the circle [cx-r, cy-r, 2r, 2r]. The mask is white inside the circle and black on land.

regions.name: Equatorial Pacific streaks
regions.land_check: No land in the circle in any of the 30 frames (it spans about 143W-122W, 9S-12N; the Marquesas at about 139.5W 9S lie just outside).
regions.overlay_check: No labels, colour bar or date text in the circle in any of the 30 frames: 0 white or neutral-grey pixels (the colours of text and colour bars) inside it, and 0 in the whole frame. The 'orig' frame set has no overlays; SVS provides the colour bar separately (sst_ecco2_cbar.png) and a separate 'with_colorbar' set. Checked 2026-11-14 by Student A, also by eye on frames 23000, 23060, 23116.

replaced.why: Looks aligned mostly because the map stretches east-west near the poles: 0.601 as drawn, about 0.16 with east-west distances corrected (cos 56.4S = 0.55).
Not chosen; Kuroshio is swirlier (0.073 vs 0.217) and has less land.
